scope: Independent Cutting calculation versions; not a direct run of the original Smart2DCutting program
comparisonRule: Unplaced quantity, unplaced area, used stock area (higher material yield for the same placed parts), non-reusable loss, largest reusable remnant. Runtime, cutting speed, cut count and cut length do not break material-quality ties.
lossDefinition: Stock area - placed part area - reusable remnant area = trim loss + kerf loss + unusable small remnants. Reusable means both sides reach the same per-job minRemnant threshold.
